trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts. It performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. The program has four generated steps: summarize_hop1, generate_query_hop2, summarize_hop2, and generate_query_hop3. Only these four steps can fail.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: 24 documents returned across three hops. Hop 1 retrieved 7 documents including Charles McDowell Jr. and Ken Burns documentaries. Hop 2 retrieved 7 documents including Ken Burns biography with dates for The Civil War (1990) and Baseball (1994). Hop 3 retrieved 10 documents including the critical 'Tunisian Victory' document (position 18).
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed all seven specified steps successfully. Hop 1 retrieved foundational documents about Charles McDowell Jr. and Ken Burns documentaries. The summarizer correctly identified missing information about Tunisian Victory and release dates. The query generator for hop 2 appropriately requested release dates for both Tunisian Victory and the Ken Burns documentaries. Hop 2 successfully retrieved Ken Burns' biography with dates for The Civil War (1990) and Baseball (1994). The second summarizer again correctly noted the absence of Tunisian Victory information. The query generator for hop 3 focused appropriately on Tunisian Victory details. Hop 3 successfully retrieved the Tunisian Victory document (position 18 in final output). All 24 documents were concatenated and returned as specified. The pipeline completed all three hops and returned the required document set.

events.summary: Hop 1 retrieval using claim verbatim retrieved 7 documents including Charles McDowell Jr. (journalist) and multiple Ken Burns documentaries
